blocks.text: Biostatistics ke bunyadi hisse mil kar hayati aur sehat ke data ko theek tarah jama, tajziya, tashreeh aur istemal karne dete hain.

blocks.alt: Chhe dabbe oopar se neeche teer ke saath: 1 Study Design and Experimental Planning, 2 Data Collection, 3 Data Management and Processing, 4 Data Analysis, 5 Interpretation of Results, 6 Presentation and Communication; har dabbe mein aik chhoti line (maslan primary or secondary data).
blocks.caption: Biostatistics ke chhe hisse, kitab ki tarteeb mein (asal khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi, sirf Roman Urdu ke liye).

items: Study design aur tajarbe ki mansooba bandi: tehqeeq ka sawal aur maqasid banana aur hypothesis jaanchne ke liye tajarbe ya mushahidati mutale tarteeb dena, jis mein aabadi chunna, variables tay karna, randomisation, uljhane wale awamil qaboo karna aur munasib sample size nikalna shamil hai. Achha design durust, qabil-e-aitbaar aur ghair janibdar nataij deta hai.
Data jama karna: primary data seedha tajarbat, surveys, interviews, mushahidat aur clinical trials se; secondary data chhapi tehqeeq, tibbi records, sarkari reports aur databases se aata hai.
Data ka intezam: tajziye se pehle data ko tarteeb dena aur durusti jaanchna, yaani safai, coding aur storage, raazdari aur saalmiyat qaim rakhte hue.

Data ka tajziya: descriptive statistics (mean, median, mode, standard deviation) data bayan karti hain; inferential statistics (hypothesis testing, regression, modelling) samples se aabadi ke baare mein nataij nikalti hain.
Nataij ki tashreeh: statistical nataij ko hayati ya sehat ke nataij mein badalna, pas-e-manzar, hudood aur mafroozon ko dekhte hue.
Pesh karna aur batana: charts, graphs aur saaf zabaan se science, tib aur awaam ke liye nataij batana, shaffaf tareeqon ke saath taa ke dobara kiya ja sake aur aitbaar bane.

blocks.prompt: Sarkari sehat report primary data hai ya secondary?
blocks.explanation: Secondary data: yeh kisi aur ka jama kiya hua maujooda data hai.

items: Design, jama karna, intezam, tajziya, tashreeh, pesh karna.
Primary data: seedha jama; secondary: maujooda zaraye.
Descriptive bayan karti; inferential aam nateeja nikalti.
